quests.desc: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First of all, open the hatch. And then, try to move east. If you can succeed at that, attempt to take a trip east. Once you get through with that, go south. That done, take a trip south. Okay, and then, go to the west. That done, venture north. Following that, venture west. And then, venture west. After that, move south. Then, recover the burger from the floor of the basement. Got that? Good!

objective: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First step, open the hatch within the playroom. After that, attempt to travel east. And then, make an attempt to take a trip east. After that, make an attempt to head south. And then, make an attempt to go to the south. After that, make an attempt to travel west. With that accomplished, make an effort to take a trip north. Next, try to go west. And then, take a trip west. Then, attempt to head south. And then, retrieve the burger from the floor of the basement. That's it!
